text:
Agriculture is often seen as an old-fashioned sector, yet it remains the foundation of every economy. This essay will outline two principal benefits for a country that focuses on agriculture: food security and a stable rural economy.

First and foremost, a strong farming sector protects a country's food security. A country that grows its own food depends less on imports and is less exposed to sudden price rises or supply problems on the world market. Reliable harvests also keep food affordable for ordinary families, which reduces hunger and protects public health. Countries that support their farmers during bad years, for example, can avoid shortages and keep prices stable. A nation that relies heavily on imported grain, in contrast, can find itself in difficulty when exporters restrict sales.

In addition, agriculture supports employment and rural stability. Farming, food processing, transport and equipment sales provide jobs and income for millions of people, particularly in areas with few other industries. This helps rural communities to remain viable, so that fewer people move to crowded cities in search of work, which in turn eases pressure on housing and services. Agricultural exports also earn foreign currency that can pay for imports of machinery and medicine. Because food is always in demand, the sector is relatively stable even when other industries face difficulties. Although farming depends on weather and is vulnerable to climate change, modern methods and insurance can reduce the risks. Governments can support this by investing in rural roads, storage and markets.

To sum up, focusing on agriculture brings clear benefits to a country, above all food security and a stable rural economy. For these reasons, it deserves sustained public support.

plan.step: 1. Khung 'benefits' và phân biệt với đề 257
plan.think: Đề 295 rộng hơn 257 (nông nghiệp nói chung, không phải đổi mới), nên chọn lợi ích khác: an ninh lương thực và kinh tế nông thôn ổn định.

plan.step: 2. Lợi ích 1 — an ninh lương thực
plan.think: Tự trồng lương thực nên ít phụ thuộc nhập khẩu và ít chịu cú sốc giá; thu hoạch ổn định giữ lương thực hợp túi tiền. Ví dụ so sánh nước hỗ trợ nông dân và nước dựa vào ngũ cốc nhập.

plan.step: 3. Lợi ích 2 — việc làm và ổn định nông thôn
plan.think: Nông nghiệp, chế biến, vận tải và bán thiết bị tạo việc làm; ít người di cư lên thành phố; xuất khẩu kiếm ngoại tệ. Nhượng bộ: phụ thuộc thời tiết, nhưng có phương pháp hiện đại và bảo hiểm.
